name: Olanzapine
route_note: Oral tablets or orally disintegrating tablets once daily; short-acting IM for agitation; long-acting pamoate depot every 2–4 weeks.
originator: Eli Lilly and Company (Erl Wood, UK)
owner: generic (many); Cheplapharm and Eli Lilly (Zyprexa, by region)

discovery.by: Jiban Chakrabarti, David Tupper and colleagues (Lilly Research Centre, Erl Wood)
discovery.note: Designed as a clozapine-like thienobenzodiazepine intended to avoid clozapine's haematological toxicity.

tagline: Clozapine-like atypical antipsychotic, effective but with marked metabolic effects
summary: Olanzapine is a second-generation antipsychotic structurally related to clozapine, used for schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It is among the more effective antipsychotics but causes substantial weight gain and metabolic disturbance. It is also used off-label for chemotherapy-induced nausea.
mechanism: Olanzapine antagonises dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, with higher 5-HT2A than D2 affinity, which is associated with antipsychotic efficacy and fewer extrapyramidal effects than typical antipsychotics.
Potent antagonism of histamine H1 and 5-HT2C receptors contributes to sedation, appetite increase and weight gain; muscarinic blockade causes anticholinergic effects.
uses: Acute mania and maintenance in bipolar I disorder
Bipolar depression and treatment-resistant depression (with fluoxetine)

history.title: Synthesis
history.detail: Olanzapine is synthesised at Lilly's UK research centre.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: The FDA approves Zyprexa for schizophrenia in September 1996.

history.title: Bipolar mania
history.detail: Olanzapine is approved for acute mania.

history.title: Symbyax
history.detail: Olanzapine/fluoxetine is approved for bipolar depression.

history.title: CATIE
history.detail: The NIMH CATIE trial finds olanzapine had the lowest discontinuation rate but the greatest weight gain.

history.title: Relprevv and settlement
history.detail: The long-acting pamoate injection is approved with a REMS for post-injection delirium sedation syndrome; Lilly pays $1.415 billion over off-label promotion.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic olanzapine launches in the US.

history.title: Lybalvi
history.detail: The olanzapine/samidorphan combination, intended to limit weight gain, is approved.

pk.metabolism: Hepatic glucuronidation and CYP1A2 (smoking increases clearance)

safety.boxed_warning: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis; not approved for this use.

facts: Olanzapine pamoate must be followed by 3 hours of observation after each injection because of PDSS.
In CATIE (2005), olanzapine had the longest time to discontinuation among the drugs studied.
